displayName: 佩皮诺·斯帕盖蒂 Peppino Spaghetti
description: Unofficial Peppino Spaghetti fan-art companion from Pizza Tower in a rounded comic desktop adaptation. Original gentle kitchen choreography includes stretching and tossing soft dough onto a plate, balancing empty pizza boxes, catching and settling his chef hat, a knee-bending hop and three-direction running. Complete chef outfit, with no knives, heat, injury or attacks. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
